Emma (Support): Hey team — customer Bob is seeing *no metrics* in Console for their Private deployment after we rolled the new auth-proxy yesterday. They report inference works but dashboards show zeros. Tenant-based metrics missing.

Bob (Customer): Confirmed. Requests succeed (200) and logs show inference. Console shows 'no data'. Example call:
`curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://onprem.example/api/v1/infer` -> 200
From proxy logs:
`[2026-02-10T14:12:05Z] INFO request id=xyz tenant= -> X-Redwood-Tenant header empty`

Javier (SRE): @Emma can you paste the request headers from the customer's gateway? Do they send X-Redwood-Tenant or an equivalent? MonitoringBot, any alerts around header drops?

MonitoringBot: Alert INC-8421 created. Pattern: high request volume with missing tenant header from onprem cluster 'corp-east-2'. First observed 2026-02-10T13:58:00Z.

Emma (Support): Customer pasted headers:
`GET /api/v1/infer HTTP/1.1\nHost: onprem.example\nAuthorization: Bearer ...\nUser-Agent: curl/7.87.0\nX-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.5\n` (no X-Redwood-Tenant)

InfraNina: That matches a recent change in the internal auth-proxy: we enabled header stripping for unknown headers to prevent header spoofing. Looks like X-Redwood-Tenant got caught. We should have whitelisted it. ?

Javier (SRE): That would explain Console's missing metrics: our ingestion checks X-Redwood-Tenant to attribute metrics. If it's gone, events become untagged and are dropped. Steps to repro locally: run curl with and without `X-Redwood-Tenant: org_123` and watch ingestion logs.

Alex (Support): Quick repro snippet for customer to verify whether proxy is stripping:
```
# should show header forwarded
curl -v -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: org_123" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://onprem.example/api/v1/infer
# then check proxy access logs for header presence
```

InfraNina: Hotfix: patch proxy config to explicitly preserve `X-Redwood-Tenant`. For envoy ingress example:
```
- name: envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_to_metadata.v3.Config
    request_rules:
      - header: "x-redwood-tenant"
        on_header_present: {key: "tenant", value: "%REQ(X-REDWOOD-TENANT)%"}
```
Alternative NGINX snippet:
```
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;
```

Javier (SRE): Can we also add a safe fallback in ingestion: if X-Redwood-Tenant missing, try to parse tenant from JWT `sub` claim for a few days while we roll the proxy fix? That would unblock the customer quickly.

InfraNina: Agreed. I'll push the proxy whitelist rollforward to canary now. Will also open a K8s rollout PR with `proxy_set_header` and a rollback plan.

Emma (Support): Triage plan for customer Bob:
- Nina: deploy whitelist patch to their cluster canary (owner: InfraNina)
- Javier: enable JWT-sub fallback in ingestion pipeline for 72h (owner: Javier)
- Alex: send Bob repro steps and temporary mitigation (owner: Alex)
- I'll update INC-8421 and add customer notes.

Bob (Customer): Thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup: Please let me know when canary is up.

InfraNina: Canary rolling (pod 3/4). I'll post timestamps.

Javier (SRE): Ingestion fallback PR opened: link: https://git.internal/r/ingest/PR-458 (test coverage included). Will monitor metrics.

MonitoringBot: Update INC-8421: proxy whitelist deployed to canary at 2026-02-10T15:04:12Z.

Emma (Support): Customer confirmed dashboards now show recent metrics (bob@example.com): 'I can see token and request counts again'. Closing loop after full rollout.

Alex (Support): Follow-up: add proxy header whitelist to standard onprem runbook + add dashboard check to alert when tenant-tagged metrics drop >90%.

Javier (SRE): Filing retrospective action item to ensure headers required by telemetry are part of our change checklist.

Emma (Support): Thanks all. Closing thread when rollout to prod completes. :white_check_mark:
